$comment: Known production advisories accepted TEMPORARILY (issue #92). scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here, and on every entry once it expires, so nothing here can be forgotten. Renewing an entry means re-reading the advisory and re-justifying the exposure in review; it is not a formality.

entries.reason: Moderate; transitive. Only unzipSync is affected and nothing here unzips untrusted input.

Every fix is Next >=15.5.24 (the two criticals included; there is no 14.2.x backport). Needs the Next 14 -> 15 migration, tracked separately. Exposure note: on Vercel, next/image is served by Vercel image optimisation rather than the self-hosted optimiser most of these target, but GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 (AVIF) matters because next.config.mjs enables image/avif.

Fix is nodemailer 10 (major), and next-auth 5 / @auth/core declare nodemailer ^7.0.7 || ^8.0.5, so the upgrade waits on them. The send route builds messages from validated strings only: no envelope/raw/jsonTransport/List-* options and no OAuth2, which is where most of these live. The two addressparser DoS advisories (GHSA-2x7j-588g-ccc2; GHSA-v53p-9fqp-m79j, quadratic backtracking in the free-text fallback, added 2026-10-04) are reachable only through the visitor's address, passed as the reply-to. Its length is now capped at 254 characters on both client and server (src/lib/contactLimits.js, pinned by tests/api/send-mail.route.test.js), down from the 16 KB body ceiling, so the quadratic cost is bounded by a real address's maximum length.
Build-time only, pulled in by next; no user-controlled CSS or source maps are processed at runtime. Resolved by the Next upgrade.
